interface.shortDescription: Personal Codex plugins and skills for review, scaffolding, UI testing, and agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Sunstack is Shravan Sunder's personal Codex marketplace for reusable agent workflows, including long-horizon delivery routing, canonical planning, plan execution, independent implementation review, project scaffolding, native UI testing, design workflows, handoffs, PR wrap-up, operations, and TUI presentation guidance.
